purpose: Teach: 國/瓦/梁/メス/霊的/孤児/村人/住職

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、國、絶対、際、絶対、医療、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、交流しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I truly appreciate the international medical exchange program our team has been part of.
lines.style: Clear and measured, steady eye contact. Pride in the work without flourish. A slight warm note when acknowledging Ren's recognition. Unhurried breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、古い病棟の、絶対、瓦、絶対、屋根、絶対、貴院、絶対、修繕されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The old ward building—I noticed the roof repairs were completed. That must have taken real effort, sensei.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, leaning slightly forward with interest. Respectful acknowledgment without flattery. A quiet admiration underneath the observation, as if noticing something that mattered to him.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、梁、絶対、の、絶対、耐震、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、確認、絶対、しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team verified the structural integrity of the beams thoroughly. It was important work.
lines.style: Factual and calm, with quiet confidence in the detail. No overstatement—just the weight of responsibility given its due. A slight nod of recognition that he noticed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、メス、絶対、滅菌、絶対、貴院、絶対、徹底、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your sterilization protocols for instruments are rigorous. That kind of care must be difficult to maintain.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Recognizing the unseen labor behind standards. Warm appreciation for the unglamorous work. Soft, measured pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、霊的、絶対、な、絶対、ケア、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、配慮しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We consider spiritual care alongside the medical—it's part of how we look after our patients.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. A hint that this isn't compromise but conviction. Speaks with the steadiness of someone who has thought about what matters. Slight emphasis on 'alongside.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、孤児、絶対、施設、絶対、と、絶対、医療連携、絶対、しているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard you partner with the orphanage in outreach. That integration must shape how you work.
lines.style: Genuinely interested, not flattering. Recognition that community partnerships change what care looks like. A slight tone of understanding the scope of it—the reach beyond clinic walls.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。離島の、本気で、絶対、村人、絶対、の、絶対、健診、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、出張しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team makes regular outreach visits to the remote islands for health screenings. The villagers depend on it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact about the necessity. No performance, just the fact of the work and what it requires. A quiet note of commitment in the pace. Unhurried, as if this is simply what happens.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お寺の、本気で、絶対、住職、絶対、と、絶対、貴院、絶対、ターミナルケア、絶対、連携、絶対、されているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand you coordinate end-of-life care with the temple priests. That kind of trust must be earned over time.
lines.style: Final thought, reflective and respectful. Aware of the depth—the spiritual and medical meeting at the hardest moments. Slower pace. A note of reverence for the collaboration without sentimentality.
